documents.title: crypto_perp class definition
documents.body:
# crypto_perp

A perpetual futures contract on a cryptocurrency, quoted and settled in USDT,
with no expiry. Funding payments exchange hands between longs and shorts to
anchor the mark price to spot.

Registry conventions for this class:

- `id` shape: `crypto_perp:<venue>:<exchange_symbol>` in lowercase.
- `venues` lists the venues where the contract trades; the seeded venue
  `binance_usdt_m` is inferred from the trading bots' USDT-M style notionals
  and fills, and must be confirmed against venue configuration before
  position-limit logic relies on it.
- `limits` keys (populated as they become known): `tick_size`, `lot_size`,
  `min_notional`, `max_leverage`, `max_position`.
- `meta.source` on seeded records names where the symbol was observed.

documents.title: crypto_spot class definition
documents.body:
# crypto_spot

A spot pair on a cryptocurrency exchange: ownership of the base asset,
settled immediately against the quote asset.

Registry conventions for this class:

- `id` shape: `crypto_spot:<venue>:<exchange_symbol>` in lowercase.
- `limits` keys are populated from the exchange's own filters:
  `tick_size`, `lot_size`, `min_qty`, `max_qty`, `min_notional`.
- `meta.base_asset` / `meta.quote_asset` name the legs; `meta.source`
  names the exchangeInfo endpoint the record was generated from.

documents.title: venue: binance
documents.body:
# venue: binance

Binance spot (api). Every `crypto_spot:binance` record lists this
venue and carries the pair's exchange-native trading limits copied from
`api/v3/exchangeInfo` at generation time.

documents.title: venue: binance_usdt_m
documents.body:
# venue: binance_usdt_m

Binance USDⓈ-M perpetual futures (fapi). Every `crypto_perp:binance_usdt_m`
record lists this venue and carries the contract's exchange-native trading
limits copied from `fapi/v1/exchangeInfo` at generation time.
